`interface TextModifier`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.font.modifier` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [TextModifier.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/font/modifier/TextModifier.java)

Changes the characters a text shows, such as its case, without changing its value.

## Description

Set one on a [`Text`](/reference/text/text/) or a [`TextElement`](/reference/text/textelement/) with `modifier(...)`, or use one of the constants.
It applies to the whole text at once and leaves the markup tags untouched.

- [Text markup and effects](/use/learn/describing-the-ui/text-markup-and-effects/)

## Method details

<a id="TextModifier-method-modify"></a>

### modify

`String modify(String text)` <span class="joid-qualifier">abstract</span>

Returns the text to show for `text`, without markup tags.

`String modify(String text, TextInfo info)` <span class="joid-qualifier">default</span>

Returns the text to show for `text`, with the tags of the markups of `info` kept as they are and the text between them modified as one string.

<a id="TextModifier-method-modifyAfter"></a>

### modifyAfter

`String modifyAfter(UnaryOperator<String> modifier, StringBuilder before, String text)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

Returns the modified form of `text` when it follows `before`, so that a modifier that depends on what comes first, such as a capital at the start, stays right across elements; `text` is appended to `before`.

<a id="TextModifier-method-camelCase"></a>

### camelCase

`String camelCase(String text, boolean upperFirst)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

Returns `text` with its words joined in camel case, the first word capitalized when `upperFirst` is `true`; any character other than a letter or a digit separates words.

<a id="TextModifier-method-capitalizeWords"></a>

### capitalizeWords

`String capitalizeWords(String text)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

Returns `text` with the first letter after each whitespace in title case.
